newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: NBT proposes to sell Softwoods stake.
newsitem.headline: NBT proposes to sell Softwoods stake.

text.p: North Borneo Timbers Bhd (NBT) said on Tuesday it was proposing not to proceed with an earlier plan to list Sabah Softwoods Sdn Bhd, and will instead sell its stake in the timber firm for 150 million ringgit.
NBT did not give any reason for the moves in its statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
But it said the proposal to sell 40-percent-owned Softwoods would result in an extraordinary gain of 87.44 million ringgit "upon completion of the proposal".
Commodities and timber firm NBT said it plans to sell Softwoods to Innoprise Corp Sdn Bhd, the investment arm of the Sabah state government.
NBT said funds received from the stake sale would help its plan to reforest an area covering some 247,000 acres at the invitation of the Sabah government.
NBT stock on Tuesday jumped 2.80 ringgit to 25.50.
